Consequences
File: kitgolden/docs/adr-001-cache.md
Qualified: ADR 001: Evict cache entries by age > Consequences
A key read constantly is still evicted after an hour, and the next read misses.

Backoff
File: kitgolden/docs/design.md
Qualified: Retry Design > Backoff
Each attempt waits twice as long as the one before, starting at half a second
and never longer than thirty seconds. The calculation lives in
[backoff.py](../scripts/backoff.py).

notes.txt
Package: kitgolden
File: kitgolden/notes.txt
Qualified: kitgolden/notes.txt
Operator notes

Restarting the store clears every cached entry; there is no persistence.

When the upstream service is down, expect each request to take up to a minute
before it fails, because of the retry backoff.

Retry Design
File: kitgolden/docs/design.md
Status: Draft

The client retries a failed call with exponential backoff, so a brief outage
does not surface as an error to the caller.

Limits
File: kitgolden/docs/design.md
Qualified: Retry Design > Limits
A call is attempted at most five times. After the fifth failure the error is
returned unchanged, and the store keeps no record of it.

Decision
File: kitgolden/docs/adr-001-cache.md
Qualified: ADR 001: Evict cache entries by age > Decision
Entries older than one hour are evicted on the next write. Eviction by age was
chosen over least-recently-used because it needs no bookkeeping on reads.
